title: Reconcile Reuse Scout module mappings and change proposals
problem: Reuse Scout handoffs number six workers inconsistently with the authoritative 13-workstream registry. Candidate records lack pinned versions and candidate-level evidence. Three prose ACR IDs do not conform to the shared ACR schema.
proposed_change: Keep the authoritative registry; route Client Platform to 6, Managed Ops/support to 10, Build Orchestration/contractors to 9, Design System to 11, and Old Nexus Audit to 12. Normalize scout proposals into ACR-0002 through ACR-0004 without treating them as accepted.
alternatives: Renumber the authoritative workstreams: rejected because it conflicts with source prompts and creates branch ownership drift.
contract_impact: No vendor selection or source-worker file modification. Owners submit corrected mappings and evidence before integration.
security_impact: Candidate discovery is not authorization, commercial clearance, or runtime security verification.
cost_schedule_impact: Removes misrouted work; no paid service is purchased by this proposal.
migration: Correct references in the source workstream after owner review; preserve original IDs in evidence.
rollback: Supersede this proposal with a reviewed correction; retain original evidence.
decision_owner: Control Tower with affected module owners
